column1: # 2026-11-09 final stock-driver build: retained optimizations, adaptive pacing off.
# Direct system loader restored; four-frame submission-order review found no
# same-frame submit-then-wait dependency. NVN async remains off; no 60FPS guarantee.
# User previously confirmed scene/text/menu/touch correctness; diagnostics off.
# Overlay window snapshot off/on/off:270/2/270 queries per recording;
# ~1414draws,54passes,3parts; user confirms graphics/text/controls/touch normal.
# Normal frame p50 20.34/17.44/20.28ms; mean producer48.19/56.35/48.61FPS.
# Normal GPU spans also vary; synchronized normal-window clocks not captured.
# Retained for268 redundant queries removed, not a fixed2.87ms CPU-cost claim.
# 227checks,145native sources; original shaders/quality/driver and all protections.
# Same-process512/1024/512, ~1529draws:60/59/60passes;4mainCBs unchanged.
# Matched512+22draw run ->534draw run: sparse GPU interval reduction~0.94ms;
# normal frame improvement~0.525ms; p95 benefit small, sustained60FPS not reached.
# User confirms graphics/text/menu normal.223checks; full per-draw hazards,
# depth/LRZ protection, full rebinding and independent CB256limit remain.
# Dynamic-state packet same-process off/on/off, matched 1530.1 draws, 61 passes, 2 dispatches:
# Full300frame queue records ~5.754M/2.541M/~5.754M: 3213210 state records omitted,
# while all 3672240 state driver calls remain. User confirms scene/text/menu normal.
# 223 checks, 145 native sources passed. Not sustained60FPS; p95 benefit remains unproven.
# Follow-up same-process 256/512/256: 1530-1531 draws, 63/61/63 physical passes;
# normal frame p50 20.25/19.71/20.45 ms. Window 512 saves ~0.64 ms versus bracketed controls.
# User confirms normal graphics/text/menu; full dependencies/rebinding and CB limit 256 retained.
# 60 FPS and stable p95 improvement are not established; 512 remains a bounded window.
# Recorder wake coalescing: controlled 64 queued records retain FIFO with 64 -> 1 notifications.
# 220 checks, 145 native sources; PJD110 startup and user gameplay/menu checks passed.
# Empty-wake rearming and concurrent producers/drain waiters tested; no FPS gain claimed.
# DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2, Hong Kong 1.7.3, KTGL / SDK 5.4.0.
# PJD110 / Adreno 750, 2026-11-06: stock-driver title and user-entered save confirmed.
# Docked dialogue, empty-barrier fix off/on/off: 18.42/30.00/18.11 FPS.
# Docked outdoor menu, same-process guarded texture-barrier off/on/off:
# 18.96/30.00/17.30 FPS; 346/52/346 passes, 1024 draws and 2 dispatches unchanged.
# Comparison held full state rebinding in all phases; guarded mode now includes it.
# Loading staging reuse: 2676 copied GPU allocations -> 7 allocations + 2669 reuses; bounded 1 MiB.
# Retained for resource reduction at user request; no loading-time improvement claimed.
# Per-pool texture index: 116 checks passed; 34816 empty pool drops bypassed full scans on PJD110.
# Same-pool overlap/alias checks retained; user confirmed save graphics and text after source merge.
# Adaptive pacing disabled at user request: outdoor menu observed 30.00 -> 45.82 FPS after restart.
# Camera differed slightly, draws 1257 -> 1382; not an exact-workload A/B or a peak-utilization claim.
# User reached the cabin with normal visible graphics; sustained progression and save/reload remain unverified.
# Same-process outdoor menu, 1441 draws: CB threshold 128 -> 256 reduced main CBs 5 -> 4
# and early submits 3 -> 2 per frame. 384 gave no further reduction; depth/LRZ rules retained.
# Scoped inputs replaced 2 full input barriers per frame; all full output barriers retained.
# Independent and combined phases stayed about 44.4-44.6 FPS / 21.9 ms; no FPS gain claimed.
# Adjacent full barriers: 49200/600 frames omitted, independent barrier intervals 217 -> 135/frame.
# Draw/pass counts and visible menu text retained; no frame-rate improvement claimed.
# CPU rebind fast path retains all state commands and removes repeated cache clears.
# Retained under the resource/work-reduction criterion, not the earlier inconclusive timing trial.
# Guarded invalidation window 128 -> 256: production-helper model keeps 1024 draws,
# reduces physical pass ends/full barriers 8 -> 4. Per-draw hazards still flush.
# PJD110 same-process 256 window: no new RED, visible game/UI graphics intact.
# Camera changed between device phases: observed counts/FPS are not a matched A/B.
# Compression audit: 36 actual targets, all format-listed, no incompatible views;
# optional driver compression query unavailable. Actual UBWC state remains unknown.
# 2026-11-07 fused presentation: 300 consecutive fused/0 legacy submits; original
# intermediate clear/blit/rotation pass omitted. No FPS effect estimate claimed.
# Usage trim: current 35 audited targets have 0 STORAGE usages; immutable bundle
# has no image-storage interfaces. Unknown/storage bundles keep original usage.
# User confirmed walking, camera, game menu, pause menu, text and touch direction.
# Stock driver, full resolution, previous barriers/LRZ protection unchanged.
# 2026-11-07 producer space credit: full300frame windows retained ~5.52M commands;
# space-check acquire loads5520203 ->7; checks5520203/5520193; wait yields0/0.
# Cached reads remain conservative; forced-full/wrap/two-producer tests passed.
# Optimized ELF cursor slots are128bytes/aligned128; original read cursor shared
# a64byte address block with the producer lock/write cursor. No alignment-only FPS claim.
# User confirmed graphics/text/menu normal;212checks and144native sources passed.
# Retained for redundant operation reduction; normal counter profiling is off.
# 2026-11-07 same-process direct/queued/direct:1459.10draws,59passes,2dispatches/frame;
# all3phases had4main render parts. Full600frame workload windows matched.
# Critical record-through-submit medians:3.65/3.01/3.68ms (includes recorder drain).
# Middle GPU gaps:3.25/2.08/2.82ms; routine frame p50:24.12/22.40/24.23ms.
# Direct diagnostic control retains wrapper costs; this is not an exact startup-off comparison.
# User confirmed graphics/text/menu normal;209checks and144native sources passed.
# Counted drain waiters fix an offline-reproduced missed-notification race;
# no claim that the race caused a previously observed device stall.
# 2026-11-07 within-draw binding coalescing: a pure300frame window removed
# 1317090 stencil/vertex API calls (4390.3/frame), with complete state reemitted.
# 207 checks passed; subsequent user confirmed graphics, text and menus normal.
# Retained for command reduction; no stable FPS gain from sparse timing claimed.
# 2026-11-07 linear cache:4096x4096 RGBA8 source unchanged in600audit frames.
# Same-process complete windows:600full uploads ->3(99.5%fewer);1462draws retained.
# User confirmed static scene/text; partial-row updates are production-tested,
# but changing source contents have not yet been exercised on this device.
